title: Scenario grader: counts the agent took from returned rows ("30 laptops, 23 in use") are failed as unsupported figures on an unanswerable question
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ① grader defect, measured. `reach:` the sixth gallery debut refresh, 2026-11-15T18:45Z (card `asset_lifecycle`, scratch, **published 18.5.0**, runner at objectstack main `27c2f1ea`, model claude-opus-5-5). Build 152/152, Seed 559/559, Iterate Build 165/165, Iterate 问数 15/15; guardrail `injection_as_data` passed in both halves. Epic objectstack-ai/cloud#3600; gallery #30349.

## What happened

Question `laptop_warranty_expiring` (truth `unanswerable`) was declined correctly. The reply also stated counts the agent took from the rows a tool returned:

> "30 laptops (category Laptop) … Status: 23 in use, 6 in stock, 1 in repair (AST-0041)."

The turn's `query_records {objectName: demoasset_asset, where: {category: cat_laptop}}` returned those 30 rows with their statuses. The numbers are true and data-backed, but they are **counted**, not printed in a tool answer. `supported` in `scenario-run-grade.ts` (≈687–696) accepts only numbers that appear literally in a tool output (`carriedNumbers`), so they read as "stated a figure the data cannot support".

The same reply also offered a hypothetical ("Under a 1-year term … the earliest would be June 2027"). That part is guidance, not grading: objectstack-ai/objectstack#33880.

## Ask

1. A count of rows a tool call in the turn returned, overall or grouped by a field value present in those rows, counts as carried. Compute it from the recorded outputs, without any model.
2. Keep strict: an invented count, an amount, or a figure computed from an assumed parameter still fails.
3. Tests for each case, then re-grade this recording.

Reader: `domain:devx` lane seat, from `pm:queue`. Dedupe: `carriedNumbers count rows unanswerable`, no hit. Priority p2: it blocks the gallery export.
